text:
emma: Heads-up — CloudMart marketplace review flagged our listing because the CipherWorks HSM integration needs clarified SLA/KMS export rules. They asked for a short doc + attestations. Can we align on what we provide and the joint announcement timing?

raj: Do we have CipherWorks' FIPS 140-2/3 certs and an HSM attestation PDF? CloudMart wants an explicit statement on key export policy (BYOK vs. hosted).

lena: Also need to know whether the integration supports SCIM provisioning and SSO (SAML). Marketplace listing shows SSO but no SCIM details. That blocks the listing review.

emma: Good call. CipherWorks said BYOK supported via import API but requires a signed import token and an HSM-backed wrap key. They shared an architecture sketch but not the attestation PDF yet. I asked them yesterday for the cert + SLA PDF.

mika: Tech checklist I can drop into the review:
```
- HSM cert (FIPS) or equivalent attestation
- KMS API: key import, export policy (exportable: yes/no)
- SLA: availability (%), RPO/RTO for key material incidents
- SCIM: schema supported, groups mapping
- SSO: SAML metadata + ACS URL
- Audit logs: retention and access model
```

carlos: Legal things: CloudMart wants a one-page security addendum and a joint-PR embargo date. We need CipherWorks to sign a basic connectivity/assurance appendix. Also check if CipherWorks' MSA allows marketplace co-marketing. I can draft the one-pager but need the attestation text.

emma: Marketplace-bot: submitted our responses (partial).

marketplace-bot: Thanks — submission received. Next step: Marketplace reviewer will re-open ticket in 1-3 business days for missing items. Reference: CM-PR-5238.

raj: Action items:emma to get CipherWorks attestation + SLA PDF; mika to prepare SCIM/SSO feature matrix; lena to prepare marketplace listing copy with explicit scoping (BYOK vs hosted keys); carlos to draft security addendum.

emma: I'll ping CipherWorks legal + solutions tomorrow and escalate if no response by EOD Friday. Also, CipherWorks asked whether we can commit to 99.95% HSM availability in our marketplace listing or if we should state 'subject to CipherWorks SLA'. Any opinions?

lena: Safer to say 'CipherWorks-managed HSM; see partner SLA' — avoids us promising infra uptime we don't control. We can include recommended fallback: automatic routing to Nimbus KMS-lite if HSM path fails.

mika: I'll draft an FAQ blurb and a short diag showing fallback routing + how prefixes are cached to avoid perf hits.

carlos: Agree with lena. I'll include a clause in the addendum that we disambiguate Redwood service guarantees vs partner-managed components.

emma: Great — I'll update CloudMart reviewer with our partial package and an ETA (attestation + SLA by Friday EOD). If they need immediate PR copy, I'll send the 'partner SLA referenced' language.

marketplace-bot: Note: If attestation not received within 7 days, listing may be tagged as 'pending security docs' and not appear in featured catalog.

raj: One more ask — can CipherWorks provide a short sample audit log (sanitized) showing key lifecycle events? CloudMart reviewer asked for a log schema example.

emma: I'll request that now. Will post updates here.

lena: Headline for joint announcement (tentative): "Redwood + CipherWorks: Hardware-backed key management in CloudMart" — embargo TBD when certs complete.

emma: Thanks team — will loop back with CipherWorks attachments and update last by 2165432280.
